claim: As Juice flew just 8640 km above the Indian Ocean, it snapped a series of images with its onboard monitoring cameras.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-13 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Universe Magazine (29 Sep 2026): on 28 Sep Juice 'passed at an altitude of 8,640 km above the Indian Ocean' and took images with its onboard cameras, its two Juice Monitoring Cameras (JMC).
